stages.title: 1. 排队 Queue
stages.summary: 排队面板与队列追踪窗口。单人/组队/房间三种队列，飞沙与周奖励展示，排队中匹配状态与取消。

windows.title: NewBattleFieldQueue
windows.summary: 1,129 sections. The mode tab strip is not authored as a strip: ShowModeTabs (NewBattleFieldQueue.decompiled.lua:4374-4451) hides every tab, then shows only the battlefield ids bound to the entry point and pins them at SetRelX(18 + i*100). InitWndBattleField (lua:4713-4744) drops modes whose IsActivityOn is false, which is why the live queue window shows 五人模式/单人模式/寻宝模式/自定义模式 (乱武模式 676 is off). Visibility follows the engine's LockShowAndHide flag (KGUI decoder clears the visible flag of locked sections; the window script is the only thing that shows them), so locked state widgets stay hidden and the script-shown ones (tabs, activity badges) are listed. The 五人模式 tab handler also sets Text_SkillTitle to STR_DESERTSTORM_TITLE (lua:4477-4488) and Text_TIP_DSTime to the schedule (lua:4350-4372). The reference screenshot state (proof/minimap/screenshots/Screenshot-given-1.png) additionally pins the 赛季 tab badges (Image_AnniversaryIcon1/2/3 at frame 23 of PartnerTeam.UITex, UpdateAnniversaryTabIcon lua:6506-6553; the INI default frame 21 is 周年), the player sample values (个人评分 1873, 飞沙令 10000/10000 via inventory `texts`), and the window's own string table string_ArenaCorpsPanel.txt, whose committed UTF-8 copy in Data/text resolves the labels the generic string.txt lacks.
elements: Handle_FEISHA / Text_AllNum / Text_WeekNum / Text_MyScore — 飞沙 currency
Bool_CreateRoom / JoinRoom / StartGame / DisbandRoom / ExitRoom — room dialogs

windows.title: MapQueue
windows.summary: Per-map queue rows with elapsed time, cancel menu and the auto-enter checkbox; fed by OnSyncMapQueueInfo. Handle_Content/_0 are parked prototypes cloned per queued map by AppendItemFromIni into Handle_List, so the default hides them and injects one authored row. UpdateListSize (MapQueue.decompiled.lua:667-745) resizes the list/bg/checkbox from the row count and then calls Collapse (lua:330-376), which sets the window to 32 + rows*48 + 32 (112 for one row) and shows Wnd_List; the inventory adjust list carries those one-row values.
elements: Per-map queue rows + 点击取消排队 context menu
自动进入 checkbox (silent entry when match found)

windows.summary: The queue match-found prompt is the engine's generic KGUI MessageBox (ui/Config/Default/MessageBox/MessageBox.ini), opened as MB_entermap by the compiled ui/script/module.lua ComfirmEnterQueuedMap handler. Body = FormatString(STR_SWITCHMAP_GFZ_TIP, map) = 需要前往的"<map>"地图吗？; option 1 = STR_HOTKEY_SURE (确定) with nCountDownTime=30 rendered through MSG_BRACKET <D0>(<D1>) = 确定(30); option 2 = STR_HOTKEY_CANCEL (取消). The script appends the body to Handle_Message (AppendItemFromString, font 18), fills Text_Option1/2, hides the 不再提示 checkbox (no tCheckBoxConfig) and Btn_Close (no bShowClose), and fnAutoClose auto-confirms when the 30 s run out. Layout replays MessageBox.lua:829-842 for this state: body 205px -> content 226x83, window 226x103, panel (Image_Bg/Glassmorphism) 282x103, option row at y=55 with buttons at x=20/118 (10px gap), ornaments anchored to Image_Bg. Viewer pages 296/297/410/512/532 replay each map's body (the page texts override the appended body); the option labels use the button's NormalFont scheme 18 (the authored Text_Option FontScheme=1 black is a stale default — the ExitPanel sure/cancel pairs carry 18); the ids come from the global g_tStrings lib ui/String/string.lua (extracted by tools/ui/extract_lua_string_table.py).

The viewer state is a composite of the two windows the client shows: WorldMap drawn behind (WorldMap_ShowBehindMiddleMap(false, true) — MiddleMap.decompiled.lua:22298, WorldMap.decompiled.lua:8314-8356 — hides the WorldMap map scroll/list and keeps its band/chrome) and MiddleMap on top. The overlay replays the WorldMap glass top band (the capture shows no HousePVP band-gradient art — those images stay script-locked), Text_Title 地图, the Handle_TipsTitle zone legend (停战区/保护区/争夺区/战争区/秘境区), CheckBox_Footprint 神行足迹, Wnd_SearchASetting (WndEdit $Placeholder 城镇或秘境) and Btn_Close; MiddleMap replays the translucent MapWindow3/4 bg tiles (Handle_Bg_0!/Handle_Mbg) + Handle_Map/Image_Map (the map area masked by Handle_Border's ShapTexture ui/Image/UItimate/UIMask/MapMask.tga, AlphaShap=1 — a soft 100x80 rounded-rect alpha stretched over the 936x764 border, applied by the viewer as a container OpacityMask so the art feathers into the glass like the capture), the 地图/探索 tabs, the list rows (Text_WM 世界 = STRING_TITLE_WORLDMAP; Text_SmallMap = Table_GetMiddleMap(id).MiddleMap0 per page = 龙门绝境/龙门绝境·夜/沧溟绝境/白龙绝境/天原绝境; Wnd_Region hidden — every battlefield row has Region=0 and UpateRegionBtn :11989-11995 returns, so the capture's 陇右 row is world-map state; Wnd_SmallMaps adjusted to (left 0, top 0) — with the region row hidden the list stacks at the container top right under the 世界 row (authored 53/161 is the parked prototype; left 6 left the map crest/text ~6 px right; the engine's FormatAllContentPos re-format is not reproduced); Image_MapLogo adjusted to top 4 because the authored top -6 draws the crest ~10 px above the capture, which centers it on Text_SmallMap (box correlation +11 px before, +0 after; capture 5.1 Example.png, measured 2026-09-30); the selected 龙门荒漠 row shows Image_BgSelect (MapWindow6 frame 7 — ink RGB (93,131,103) matches the capture's bar (91,118,100), not frame 33's (50,95,88)), so the viewer hides Image_BgNormal/Image_BgOn and places Image_BgSelect at top 5 (authored -5 puts the bar's bottom edge 10 px above the capture's; same runtime row-placement fit as the crest), the bar now aligning at +3/+1 px like the rest of the list), no NPC filter rows: all five packs ship an empty minimap/npc.tab (0 bytes) and no doodad.tab, so UpdateNpcDoodad :5978-6043 appends nothing (the capture's ten rows 地图内交通…碑铭 and its 跨地图交通/其他商人 checks are the world map 龙门荒漠's 33-row npc.tab and the player's saved StorageServer MiddleMap_SelectNpc filter — world state; Image_NpcOption frame 0 checked / 4 unchecked, :501-504, when a page ever carries rows). The trunk rows (Handle_NpcTrunk/Handle_CraftTrunk, cloned from Handle_Mode by UpdateAreaOrNpcList :5660-5705) are hidden on the battlefield pages — an empty list shows no title and the packs carry no rows (the capture's world state shows them because its 龙门荒漠 pack has rows); when a page carries rows the trunk art is the Image_ListBg1/Bg2 eye (MapWindow6 frame 32 open / 35 closed; UpdateAreaOrNpcTruckState :4501-4592 swaps them with the expand state), with the authored-visible Image_ListCover (frame 30 magnifier) and Image_Minimize hidden (list-template hide). The NPC list scrollbar (Scroll_List) is hidden as well — the capture shows no scrollbar (its list fits; ours is empty). Image_Search is diced (adjust imageType 10): the client draws the 20x20 Common frame 0 box art with 1 px borders although the INI omits ImageType — the stretched render showed a 13 px left/right band (the extra-dusted area), the capture 1 px. Also replayed: the 标记设置 button and the scale/alpha sliders. The window is placed 27 px below the WorldMap band (inventory `offsetY`; the WorldMap stays at the client top) — the capture shows the 地图 tab underline at y=113 and the list/bottom bar/art ~+27 vs the authored positions; the runtime NPC title row is 43 px tall (inventory `adjust Handle_Mode`; the authored 54 is the editor height — with it the panel rows land at the capture's 228.6/266.9), and the tab state is the script's: `CheckBox_MapPage` checked (inventory `images.checked`; the capture paints the selected frame, the script calls `Check(true)` :20817/20942) and `CheckBox_ExplorePage` hidden (the script hides it when `GetMapExploreInfo(mapID)` is empty :3920-3958; the capture shows no 探索 tab). windows.title: BattleFieldMap
windows.summary: Draggable battlefield M-map panel with the map art in Image_Map — pages 296/297/410/512/532 take it from each map's minimap pack (like the loading and M windows). The map-suffixed team/line elements exist only for 512 and 709 in the INI (Image_MapLine_512_*, Image_CLine_512_*, Handle_Team_512_* with Image_Num*_512_*/Image_Team[M/L]512_*/Text_512_*, plus the Image_M709_*/Handle_Team_709_* set); the runtime looks up Handle_Team_<currentMapID>_n (:3324-3358) and Image_CLine_ (:3653), so the four other pages hide both sets (page hide *_512_* + *709_*) and page 512 hides *709*, leaving only map 512's ring segments + team numbers. The window-level hide drops what belongs to other modes or to runtime data: the faction/camp set (CheckBox_Hq/Er + Handle_Hq/Er, Handle_MainCmd_*/Handle_OtherCmd_*, Handle_CampObBoard), the top-bar mode controls (Wnd_Route line tabs + CheckBox_Follow — the 绝境 line-choose phase, hidden at init and after MIDDLE_MAP_ON_JUEJING_STOPCHOOSELINE; CheckBox_ShowNum + Btn_Refresh — CanShowHeatMap (map.lua:347-371) is true only for IsInTongWarFieldMap or CommandBase.CanShowHeatMap, never for a treasure map, so 显示人数/刷新 do not belong here), the heat-map grid (Handle_GFAreaList/Handle_GFArea/Handle_GFList_Num) and the runtime item prototypes the client clears/appends (Handle_DataMod/Image_Data, Handle_MapIcon, Handle_Gather/Mark/Arrow, Handle_EventMod, Image_DrawLine1, Image_Player, Image_Teammate). Viewer fix: the skin filter no longer counts ui/Image/MiddleMap/StormLine/* art as old-skin chrome — with the heat-map items hidden it classified the whole Handle_Map layer as an old root and dropped the map as a duplicate of Image_Bg. When IsInTreasureBattleFieldMap() it shows Handle_StormLine and registers MapCircle/SFX_CircleNew; only map 512 ships line data in the INI (Image_CLine_512_* — the choice-line ring, shown; the runtime grays/normalizes one line, ShowLootMode :3636-3679) — the other maps have none, so no storm line is drawn for them; the 圈 is the SFX_CircleNew particle (C_自己圈范围_677.pss), no bitmap, not rendered. Heat map toggle; mark/gain/sfx notify events.
evidence: proof/minimap/ui/Image/MiddleMap/StormLine/StormLine3.UITex (16 frames: f0-9 generic segments, f10-15 the map-512 set)

windows.title: LootList
windows.summary: Container loot window (OnSyncLootList): the Lua rebuilds the list per container - a money row when GetLootMoney>0 (UpdateMoneyShow splits gold/silver/copper, lua:616+) then one Handle_Item row per GetLootList entry (Text_Item = GetItemNameByItem colored by GetItemFontColorByQuality; Box_Item gets SetObject/SetObjectIcon/SetOverText count, lua:479-577); Image_Auction shows only for the loot master (IsDistributeMan, lua:585-604). Btn_Sure label = STR_PICK_ALL .. FormatString(STR_BRACKETS, GetKeyShow(AUTOINTERACT)) = 全部拾取［F］ (lua:112-124). Viewer replays a sample container with the two requested items only (no money row): 麻布绷带 / 月影沙 stacked via the list clones; the item names replay SetFontColor via the engine's FontColor key (viewer `fontColor` text override) and the slot art carries a rarity frame (viewer `borderColor` image override, approximating UpdateItemBoxExtend); the rarities are 麻布绷带 = 优良/green2, 月影沙 = 精良/blue2 (provisional — settings/Item/Item.tab is not in the local extracts). The static templates, Image_Auction and the mouse-over glows are hidden. The item icons are extracted from the UI pak (`ui/Image/Icon/System/Drug/...`; the icon registry `ui/Scheme/Case/icon.txt` maps icon id -> UITex+frame): 麻布绷带 = icon 6011 (`System\Drug\CL_0417_01`, a cloth roll), 月影沙 = icon 1321 (`System\Drug\medicNew01b`, the blue powder) — both reasoned picks from the shipped icon sets, provisional until the item table is reachable; the viewer paints them on the Box slots (new Box `Image` support). Count overlays (Box:SetOverText) are not reproduced. Pickup bar (拾取/打开/操作) + smart-loot settings live outside this window; MaxLootRange = 5.

windows.title: ACC_TreasureFinal
windows.summary: 寻宝（绝境）最终结算 (1920x700, module ACC_TreasureFinal, script ui/Config/Default/BattleField/ACC_TreasureFinal.lua). The title band (Handle_Title) shows the team rank (Text_Rank = FormatString(STR_TREASURE_RANK, nRank, nTotal), badge art Image_Title/Image_TitleBg1 from Table_GetTreasureInfoTitle and the big digits Handle_Rank Image_Num1/Num2/Image_Ming), rank 1-3 also play Handle_SFX SFX_Copper/Silver/Gold. The my-team rows clone Handle_Player inside Handle_FinalList (Update: rows = GetMyTeamMemberData(nTeamID) sorted by field 12; TemplateGetRowData maps Name->Text_PlayerName, DECAPITATE_COUNT->Text_KillNum, KILL_COUNT->Text_XSNum, BEST_ASSIST_KILL_COUNT->Text_BestZGNum, HARM_OUTPUT->Text_HarmNum, SPECIAL_OP_3->Text_JJFenNum, SPECIAL_OP_6->Text_ResultNum; per-row AWARD_1/2/3 in Handle_Reward -> Image_AwardIcon frames on ui/Image/UITga/DesertStorm.UITex + Text_AwardNum). Handle_Fail/Handle_Win carry the ZS ribbon state art, the header labels live in Handle_Titile (STR_FBLIST_DUIYUANMINGZI/STR_TIPS7/STR_BF_KILL1/STR_BF_ZJZG/STR_BF_DAMAGE/STR_SHOW/STR_SHOW2/STR_GETCITY_JIANGLI), Text_Time = STR_BATTLEFIELD_TIME_USED, Text_WarningTime = STR_NEW_BANISH_1..2 banishing countdown, Btn_Leave -> LeaveALLBattleField (Text_Leave = STR_UISET_BFCENCEL), Btn_Export -> ExportData (Text_Export = STR_FACELIST_DAOCHUMIANJU, STR_CONTENST_INFO_EXPORT_SUCCESS), Wnd_PersonCard opens the clicked member's PersonalCard. Sample rows are placeholders in the window's real formats: Text_Line = '/' so Text_KillNum+Line+XSNum read as the 击/助 pair, Text_BestZGNum = 最佳助攻, Text_HarmNum is 万-formatted, Text_JJFenNum = 本场表现分, Text_ResultNum = 个人评分结算; the rank badge keeps the INI's authored digits (第18名) and Text_Rank carries the matching 队伍排名 text. The PVPUI12 chrome (LockShowAndHide=1) stays off. The window ships no opaque background: its only backdrop art is the semi-transparent veil Image_Bg1 (PVPShowFinal1 frame 11, ImageType=12, ~23% alpha) plus the row bands, composed over the live game world on the client, so the viewer renders it over a neutral tone (`backdrop` #33393E) instead of black; with the personal-card column out of scope the table block is centered on the window (Handle_Titile 403, Handle_FinalList 415). Verified against the capture (downscaled 1/1.73 to design px): button labels follow the engine's WndButton NormalFont, not the child Text scheme (Btn_Leave scheme 3 = 16px white, Btn_Export scheme 18 = 15px white - the authored Text_Leave 28/Text_Export 27 are copy-paste leftovers; 25% of shipped buttons differ), the banishing countdown is the runtime AppendItemFromString sequence in Handle_WarningTime (将在 f257 / seconds f258 yellow2 / 秒后传出战场 f257, viewer `appends` with flow), and the 击/助 pair packs tight because Text_Line is AutoSize=1 PosType=9 (the viewer now measures AutoSize text instead of using the authored box). 导出数据 is hidden per the user's call (the capture shows it, but the viewer drops it: hide Btn_Export). The window is a full-screen overlay centred on the screen (the editor parks the root at (screen-window)/2), so the viewer renders it inside a 1920x1080 screen frame (`screenWidth`/`screenHeight`) with the window centred on the neutral backdrop - the veil reads as the in-game band instead of filling the render.

windows.summary: Client exit / return confirm dialog (420x108, anchored TOPCENTER,TOPCENTER,0,360 below the screen top; ShowModeID 27,26,24,22,12,36). OpenExitPanel(szReason) sets Text_ExitGame from g_tStrings: close -> EXIT_QUIT 你确定要退出游戏吗？, loginclose -> EXIT_LOGIN_QUIT 你确定要退出游戏吗？, returntologin -> EXIT_RETURN_LOGIN 你确定要返回到登录吗？, returntorole -> EXIT_RETURN_CHOOSE 你确定要返回到角色选择吗？ (ExitPanel.lua). Btn_Sure (确定, STR_SURE) exits the game / ReInitUI by the reason, Btn_Cancel (取消, STR_CANCEL) plus Esc/Enter close it. Image_Back is a runtime full-screen dimmer: UpdateBgImageSize sizes it to Station.GetClientSize() and pins it to the window origin; it stays hidden in the static render (screen context, like the world backdrop). The warning icon and the glass PanelBg/PanelBg18 ornaments come from UItimate. The shipped Text_ExitGame leaves HAlign at the left default although its 241-wide box is glued to the icon (76..348, group centred on the 420 dialog) and no shipped reason fills it, so the viewer centres the message in its box (`adjust hAlign=1`) and moves the icon to the message's left edge (Image_Warning left=124, the authored 76 assumed a full-width message); re-open when a capture of the live dialog is available.
